title: Deduplicate bridge game log result construction
description: `BridgeCallbackHandler.getGameLogChunk()` and `getGameLogSinceTurn()` both assemble bridge log responses from the same underlying event cache, cursor bookkeeping, rendering, and truncation rules. Consolidate the shared event-fetch/result-building path so future changes to log payload semantics only have one source of truth while preserving the current distinctions between cursor deltas, since-turn slices, chat inclusion, and total-length reporting.
